dict.string: Two tools, per app: a SOUND COOLDOWN mutes repeat notifications for a while after one makes noise (they still show on the lock screen — they just stop dinging), and REGEX FILTERS drop notifications whose text matches, entirely.
Default: 2 minutes. While a cooldown is running, that app's notifications are silent but still appear as normal. When it expires, the next one sounds and the timer restarts. 0 = never mute.

Per app: override the cooldown and add regex filters. A notification matching any filter is blocked completely — no banner, no lock screen, no badge. Filters are case-insensitive regex matched against title + subtitle + body, e.g. Get up|daily reminder. Changes apply instantly.
